purpose: Acceptance values the owner chose for A7 qualification procedures. Hand-written, not generated. Each value is a project choice (PROJECT-CHOICE), not a measurement or a manufacturer limit.

cycles.meaning: Insert and extract each jack 100 times at up to 10.0 N with no crack, shift or loosening of the panel, nut or jack. This checks the panel-side retention, not the jack's life (the maker states 4,000-5,000 cycles at rated load).

reverse.meaning: No external voltage is applied to +3V3 while +5 V is off (no SWD-probe or other back-powering). The test checks only power-up and power-down sequencing, and that VOUT <= VIN + 0.3 V holds at power-down.
